hints.title: Consecutive Homogeneous Runs
hints.text: Group adjacent identical characters into runs and evaluate their individual lengths.

hints.title: Decomposing Run Lengths
hints.text: Each run must decompose into chunks of size 3, with exactly one run across the entire string contributing one chunk of size 2.

hints.title: Remainder Analysis modulo 3
hints.text: A length L with L % 3 == 0 uses all 3-chunks. A length with L % 3 == 2 uses one 2-chunk. If L % 3 == 1, it must be at least 4 to use one 2-chunk (since 4 = 2 + 2 or 1 + 3 is invalid).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Two pointer linear scan over consecutive equal runs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over possible partition sizes incurs exponential time overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since chunks must contain identical characters, chunk boundaries cannot cross different characters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice each run cannot cross character boundaries and use modulo 3 arithmetic.
